manifest.claim_text: The acoustic solver reproduces free-field spreading and satisfies the Helmholtz equation, validated independently of any neural-response model.
manifest.falsified_by: relative error above tolerance, or a Helmholtz residual that does not vanish under grid refinement
manifest.consequence_if_failed: The acoustic solver may not be used for tFUS exposure or targeting; every downstream acoustic claim is suspended.
non_goals: These checks establish code correctness only. Numerical correctness is necessary, never sufficient: agreement with recorded signals is stronger, held-out perturbation stronger still (thesis §0.2).
